# Semlink 2.4.0

A focus-and-polish release: the chat header always tells you which conversation you are in, the history drawer and project picker get a full visual pass, interrupted answers keep what they already said, and translated tables render correctly.

## 🏠 Header shows the conversation

- The header center now permanently displays the current conversation's title (its first question); on the home screen it shows the Semlink brand. Scrolling no longer shifts the title — it stays exactly in place
- Very long titles truncate with an ellipsis and can no longer push the header buttons onto a second line, at any panel width

## 🗂 History drawer, aligned

- The conversation you are currently viewing is highlighted in the drawer and the highlight follows when you switch
- Session rows, project rows, group headers and time buckets share one left edge; rows are more compact
- The pin action sits inline with the row actions instead of occupying a fixed slot, and the archive entry lives at the right end of the "Conversations" group header (the old full-card archive view is retired)
- Renaming a project in its dialog now updates the drawer immediately

## 🎛 Project picker, reworked

- Breadcrumb chips: click any chip to step back one level, or click a parent segment to jump straight there
- The drill-down panel uses unified 36 px rows in a fixed-height panel, highlights only what the pointer is on, and drops the persistent gray background on the selected item
- The "All notes" row is gone — once a project is selected, hovering its chip turns the folder icon into an ✕ and clicking clears the scope back to the whole vault
- The create button uses the standard accent color, consistent with the custom-provider dialog

## ✏️ Dialogs

- Six dialogs (chat models, Feishu bot, progress, project, save note, share) moved their titles into Obsidian's native modal title bar, and Cancel consistently sits to the left of Confirm

## ⏹ Stop keeps what was said

- Stopping a generation no longer wipes the answer: the partial reasoning panel and whatever text already streamed in stay visible with a "Stopped" note, and both persist when you reopen the conversation

## 🌐 Translation fixes

- Tables no longer break while an answer is being translated: a table that arrives across streaming chunks now renders as one complete table instead of collapsing to a header-only fragment

## 🎨 Brand

- The sparkles line logo moved into a standalone asset file shared by the tab icon and the share page, with its stroke width matched to Obsidian's built-in icons

**Download**: main.js, manifest.json and styles.css are attached to this release. Updating from inside Obsidian picks up all three automatically.
